mapper.select: select * from seckill_activity sa left join seckill_product sp on sa.id = sp.activity_id where sp.sku_id = #{skuId} and sa.id != #{activityId} and status != 2 and sa.deleted = 0

select sa.id, sa.name, sa.start_time, sa.end_time, sa.status, sa.merchant_id, sum(sp.seckill_stock) as productCount from seckill_activity sa left join seckill_product sp on sa.id = sp.activity_id where sa.status in (0,1) and sa.deleted = 0 group by sa.id, sa.name, sa.start_time, sa.end_time, sa.status, sa.merchant_id order by sa.status desc, sa.start_time
